text:
Maya G: Taking over primary for tonight's APAC overlap — I'll be primary from 18:30 UTC -> 02:30 UTC. Before I fully switch, quick access checklist so we don't get surprised mid-incident: PagerDuty push & mobile, ability to assume `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Prod-Oncall`, Grafana 'ops_view' + alerting, and K8s cluster view (prod). Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff

OpsBot: :bell: PagerDuty rotation will change at 18:30 UTC. Suppressions set for 18:40-18:50 UTC for infra maintenance. Open incidents will remain assigned.

Samir Patel: I'm secondary until 02:00 PT (which is 09:00 UTC). Quick checks: PD mobile pings? yes. PD role: Responder (can ack/resolve but not modify schedules). If we need to edit schedule/suppressions, tag @Ritesh or @Carlos.

Ritesh B: Confirming I can edit PD schedules. For AWS access, run these locally to validate session:
```
aws sso login --profile redwood-prod
aws sts get-caller-identity --profile redwood-prod
kubectl --context prod get pods -n inference
```
If `aws sso login` errors, likely SSO session expired or MFA prompt blocked — DM me and I can kick a short-lived role for you.

Lina (oncall): Grafana check done: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/prod-overview — I have 'ops_view' but not 'ops_admin'. That means I can see dashboards and alert links but cannot change alert rules or add notification channels. If we need to rewire an alert to a different PD service, ping @Ritesh. PD push notifications are coming through on my phone.

Carlos: Heads-up — APAC overnight 00:00-04:00 UTC currently has only one oncall (Maya). If Lina signs off early there's a coverage gap. Options: Samir extend shift by 2 hours? Or Ritesh can cover 00:30-03:30. Which works?

Samir Patel: I can extend to 04:00 UTC if needed, but I'll need confirmation I'm allowed to escalate (my PD role is Responder). If we need escalation rights, @Maya can add a temporary override or @Ritesh can make me an ad-hoc escalator for tonight.

Maya G: I will create a temporary PD override to allow Samir to escalate for the window 23:30-04:30 UTC. Using the PD CLI:
```
pd overrides:create --service "prod-inference" --start "2026-03-14T23:30:00Z" --end "2026-03-15T04:30:00Z" --user "samir@redwood.com" --description "Temporary escalate for APAC overlap"
```
I'll post the override ID after it's created. It expires automatically.

Ritesh B: Note for Grafana troubleshooting: if a panel shows `No data`, check the query timeframe and datasource (influx -> prod-metrics). Also, alert routing config lives in ops-sre repo under `infra/alert-routing.yaml` — you'll need repo read to open PRs.

Lina (oncall): Quick access help if someone loses PD push: open PD mobile > Account > Resend verification. For AWS SSO issues, try clearing browser cookies or use `aws sso login` from laptop (not phone). For Grafana MFA problems, file a ticket to infra-access with `access: grafana` tag.

OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Handoff checklist status: PD mobile: OK, AWS assume-role: maybe (Samir flagged SSO), Grafana view: OK (Lina), K8s access: OK for Maya & Ritesh.

Carlos: Thanks — can you drop the PD override ID here when created? Also please add a short note to the runbook about the APAC coverage gap so we don't forget next week.

Maya G: Override created: ID `ovr_8a7f3`. I've appended a note to the runbook `https://go/redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff` under 'APAC gaps' with recommended rotation. Leaving handoff: @Samir Primary, @Lina Secondary (unless Lina signs off). If anybody loses access, ping the `#eng-oncall` channel and @Ritesh for emergency schedule edits. :thumbsup:
